IT IS FURTHER ORDERED THAT JULIAN T. LASTOWSKI, ATTORNEY FOR DEFENDANT DEBRA GREY, SHALL FORTHWITH RELEASE FROM HIS TRUSTEE ACCOUNT, AND PAY OVER TO PLAINTIFF JEFFREY LITKE THE SUM OF $2141.72. IT IS FURTHER ORDERED THAT THE MUNICIPAL COURT CLERK'S OFFICE SHALL FORTHWITH RELEASE AND PAY OVER TO PLAINTIFF JEFFREY LITKE THE SUM OF $8954.28.

SAID TOTAL OF THE ABOVE COMBINED AMOUNTS, $11096 REPRESENTS THE AMOUNT OF RENT DUE AND OWING PLAINTIFF FOR THE PERIOD OF MARCH 1993 TO APRIL 1995, AT THE AGREED RATE OF $584.00 A MONTH. IT S FURTHER ORDERED THAT JULIAN T. LASTOWSKY, ATTORNEY FOR DEFENDANT DEBRA GREY, SHALL RETAIN THE BALANCE OF $778.28 IN HIS TRUSTEE ACCOUNT UNTIL FURTHER ORDER OF COURT.
